description: The published commercial terms for one product: pricing type, currency, minimum order quantity, the quantity bands and any approved indicative unit price per band, validity date, Incoterms and lead time. Any price returned is indicative and never a quotation: it carries binding false, it excludes freight, duty and taxes, and the highest quantity band is always a quotation rather than a figure. Most products are priced on request, and those return no number at all.

quantity.description: Units, to get the band that applies
